forms.title: Personio job page -> /apply DynamicForm (pre-uploaded documents, JSON attributes, in-place thank-you)
quirks: entry is the job page; the form is behind 'Apply for this job' on /job/<id>/apply
Name group: one visible 'Name' label with sr-only First/Last labels and placeholders
available_from is a free text input (placeholder 'Available from'), not a date input
recruiting_channel_id select with numeric ids; custom_attribute_<id> select with custom_option_<id> values; multi-select as checkboxes joined with ','
Documents: one 'Add file' button per category over a hidden multiple file input; each file uploads immediately (POST /api/v1/documents -> uuid)
Submit Application stays disabled until required fields, CV upload, privacy checkbox and the (invisible) Turnstile token are all present
JSON submit with Idempotency-Key header; attributes as [{id,value}]; files referenced by uuid + category
success replaces the form with the company's thank-you HTML in place (no navigation)
forms.reference: Live <company>.jobs.personio.de/job/<id>/apply SSR markup and the personio-jobs apply page chunk (uploadDocuments /api/v1/documents, submitApplication /api/v1/jobs/<id>/application), studied read-only
